Ten years ago, Koike was a down-and-out middle-aged man, crushed by 20 million yen in debt and with nowhere left to turn. At his lowest point, he encountered the mysterious Mr. Universe and the Laws of the Universe, and learned to make wishes—placing "orders" with the universe using a simple yet powerful mantra. Amazingly, this practice transformed his life. He documented this miraculous journey of turning thoughts into reality in his book, "From 20 Million Yen in Debt to Manifesting My Desires Every Day." His story has since inspired countless readers to rewrite their own lives—and Koike himself has gone on to become a sought-after spiritual coach, helping others follow the same path of transformation
